title: Light, Lovely Steamed Peruvian Potatoes Causa Limena
description: Tender, earthy peruvian potatoes in a creamy sauce, served in a korean brass bowl. A delicious and crowd-pleasing causas limenas recipe.

ingredients.name: 4 large yukon gold potatoes, peeled and halved
1 medium red onion, peeled and thinly sliced
ingredients.notes: make sure to slice thinly for even cooking

ingredients.name: 1 cup heavy cream
ingredients.notes: make sure to choose a heavy cream that is whole30 friendly

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.
Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and add the potato halves. Steam the potatoes for 15 minutes, or until tender when pierced with a fork.
While the potatoes are steaming, heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced red onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly caramelized.
Stir in the ground cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Remove the potatoes from the steamer and carefully place them on a baking sheet. Drizzle with the cumin-spiced onion mixture and dot with butter.
Transfer the potatoes to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy on top.
While the potatoes are baking, heat the heavy cream in a small saucepan over medium heat until simmering.
Stir in the grated fresh ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and serve in korean brass bowls with the creamy ginger sauce spooned over the top.
